description: Enlargement of door opening, construction of a glazed conservatory to the rear elevation; and alteration to first floor rear window.
decision_conditions:
The location of this proposal is sited within the CA33 Mortlake Conservation Area which affords trees both within and adjacent to the site of the proposal, statutory protection. The applicant/agent is advised that the proposed extension works would be in close proximity to neighbouring trees sited within this conservation area.  Harm to the longevity of these trees, if roots, limbs etc. are damaged is a prosecutable offence and you are advised to take precautionary steps to ensure these trees would not be prejudiced by this development.
 
If any works are required to the trees, including tree roots, this would require prior approval from the Local Planning Authority.  This decision would be based on the merits of the application and not prejudiced by the decision to issue this planning permission.  If you require further advice on the subject please contact the arboriculture department on the following e-mail: Trees@richmond.gov.uk.
